title: Unit 3: That's Entertainment: Comparatives & Superlatives
objective: Mampu membandingkan benda, orang, atau tindakan menggunakan comparative dan superlative adjectives; menggunakan struktur (not) as...as untuk perbandingan; serta membentuk comparative adverbs untuk memperkuat atau melemahkan perbandingan.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara membandingkan dua atau lebih hal dalam bahasa Inggris. Kamu akan belajar membentuk comparative (lebih...) dan superlative (paling...) dari adjective, menggunakan pola (not) as...as untuk menyatakan kesamaan atau perbedaan, serta membuat comparative adverbs untuk menjelaskan bagaimana suatu tindakan dilakukan dengan lebih baik atau lebih buruk.
rules: Comparative adjectives: Tambahkan -er pada kata sifat pendek (cheap → cheaper), atau gunakan 'more' untuk kata panjang (expensive → more expensive). Contoh: Digital video is cheaper than 35mm film.

Superlative adjectives: Tambahkan -est pada kata sifat pendek (cheap → the cheapest), atau gunakan 'the most' untuk kata panjang (expensive → the most expensive). Contoh: Monsters was one of the best films of the year.
(not) as...as comparatives: Gunakan 'not as + adjective + as' untuk menyatakan perbedaan. Contoh: Extras aren't as expensive as actors.

Making comparisons stronger/weaker: Gunakan 'a lot/much/far' untuk memperkuat, atau 'a little/a bit' untuk melemahkan. Contoh: Independent movies are a lot more interesting. / I had to make it a little shorter.
Comparative adverbs: Bentuk dari adjective dengan menambahkan -ly, lalu tambahkan 'more' di depan. Contoh: carefully → more carefully. Beberapa irregular: fast → faster, good → better, bad → worse.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula keliru menggunakan 'more' bersama dengan '-er', atau lupa menggunakan 'than' setelah comparative. Ingat: gunakan salah satu bentuk saja, dan selalu tambahkan 'than' saat membandingkan dua hal.
commonTrap.wrong: This film is more cheaper than that one.
commonTrap.correct: This film is cheaper than that one.

vocab.collocation: We're used to hearing about really expensive Hollywood films.
Do you need millions of dollars to make a successful movie?
Monsters had a budget of more than $250 million.
The final film looks nearly as professional as big, fancy Hollywood productions.
The contestants can win £10,000 in the game show.
Football isn't as exciting as skiing.
Madagascar is an animated film and it's a comedy, too.
Extras are the people who stand around and do things but don't say anything.

dialogue.context: Megan dan teman-temannya membicarakan rencana syuting film di taman. Megan sangat bersemangat karena aktor favoritnya, Gregory Harris, akan berada di lokasi syuting.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Guys, guys! Guess what! They're going to make a film here.
lines.translation: Teman-teman! Coba tebak! Mereka akan membuat film di sini.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: We have. They're going to do some filming in the park. For a new sci-fi movie. And Megan's really excited.
lines.translation: Kami sudah tahu. Mereka akan melakukan syuting di taman. Untuk film sci-fi baru. Dan Megan sangat bersemangat.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: I really am. Gregory Harris is in the film. He's so cool. In fact, I think he's my favourite actor of all time!
lines.translation: Aku benar-benar bersemangat. Gregory Harris ada di film itu. Dia sangat keren. Bahkan, kurasa dia aktor favoritku sepanjang masa!

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Don't get too excited, Megan. You're not going to meet him. Or even see him, probably.
lines.translation: Jangan terlalu bersemangat, Megan. Kamu tidak akan bertemu dengannya. Atau bahkan melihatnya, mungkin.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: Don't be so sure, Luke. The thing is, they want extras for the film.
lines.translation: Jangan begitu yakin, Luke. Masalahnya, mereka butuh figuran untuk film itu.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Extras? You know – the people who stand around and do things but don't say anything.
lines.translation: Figuran? Kamu tahu – orang-orang yang berdiri di sekitar dan melakukan sesuatu tapi tidak bicara apa-apa.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang jenis film dan acara TV favoritmu. Ia ingin tahu pendapatmu dan membandingkan preferensimu.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Let's talk about entertainment today. What kind of films do you like? Do you prefer action films or animated films?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I prefer animated films because they are more interesting and fun.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great! Now, what about TV programmes? Which do you think is more exciting – a game show or a sports programme?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think game shows are more exciting than sports programmes because they are more fun to watch.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! One more question: Do you think expensive films are always better than cheaper films?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: No, I don't think expensive films are always better. Sometimes cheaper films are more creative and interesting.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Well done! You're using comparatives very well. Keep practicing and you'll get even better at expressing your opinions!

quiz.question: Digital video is _______ than 35mm film.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'cheap' adalah adjective pendek (satu suku kata), jadi bentuk comparative-nya adalah 'cheaper' dengan menambahkan -er.

quiz.question: Moviefone thought Monsters was one of the _______ films of the year.
quiz.explanation: Superlative dari 'good' adalah 'best' (bentuk irregular). Digunakan untuk membandingkan dengan semua film lain di tahun itu.

quiz.question: Extras aren't _______ expensive _______ actors.
quiz.explanation: Pola (not) as...as digunakan untuk menyatakan bahwa dua hal tidak sama. 'Extras aren't as expensive as actors' berarti extras lebih murah.

quiz.question: She should think _______ carefully than her sister did.
quiz.explanation: Comparative adverb dibentuk dengan 'more + adverb'. 'More carefully' berarti 'lebih hati-hati'.

quiz.question: Independent movies are _______ more interesting than Hollywood blockbusters.
quiz.explanation: Untuk memperkuat comparative, gunakan 'a lot', 'much', atau 'far' sebelum 'more'. 'Very' dan 'too' tidak digunakan dengan comparative.

quiz.question: The final script was a little _______ than the first version.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'little' digunakan untuk melemahkan comparative. Bentuk comparative dari 'short' adalah 'shorter'.
